lines.text: Once upon a time, on a quiet, dusty little world, far, far away... the wind whistled through great big mountains of junk.
And way down at the bottom of those mountains, there lived a little robot, named Bolt.
Hi! I'm Bolt!
Every single day, Bolt had one very important job.
Scoop the junk... squish the junk... and stack, stack, stack!
Oh no, oh no!
Oopsie!
Bolt was a very hard worker. But when the sun went down, at the end of each day... Bolt felt a little bit lonely.
Hello? Anybody?
Then one morning, Bolt found something he had never, ever seen before.
Wow... so pretty!
Something small. Something green. Something... alive!
But before Bolt could show anybody... whoosh! Something came zooming down from the sky!
Scanning. Scanning.
Hello?
Oh! Hello there! I'm Luma!
Hi! I'm Bolt!
Wait... is that a plant? You found a real, live plant!
Luma had flown across the whole wide sky, looking for a sign of life. And Bolt... well, Bolt had been waiting his whole life for a friend.
So together, they found the perfect spot... and planted the little sprout in the ground.
Grow... please grow!
They waited, and waited, all through the long, starry night.
And when the sun came up... something magical happened!
Whoa, look!
Yay! Hooray!
Because when you take care of something small, with lots and lots of love... it grows, and grows, and grows!
And Bolt was never, ever lonely again.
Friend!
Best friends!
The End.
